title: REVER Ride Log Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Garmin Zumo ride data (`garmin:zumo`), motorcycle OBD-II telemetry (`obd:bike`), RaceChrono laps (`racechrono:lap`), REVER rides (`rever:ride`), and RevZilla orders (`revzilla:order`).
app: Garmin Zumo ride exports, motorcycle OBD-II telemetry, RaceChrono track sessions, REVER ride logs, and RevZilla order history forwarded into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rever:ride
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(ride_type) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many REVER ride log events land each day and how many distinct ride type values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest REVER ride log records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct ride type values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how much REVER ride log activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
